North Korea's Kim Jong Un plans nuclear-armed navy, commissions warship

North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has announced plans to bolster the nation's navy with nuclear weapons and commissioned a new, large warship. State media reported the commissioning of a 5,000-ton destroyer, which Kim touted as a symbol of advancing naval nuclear capabilities. The move signals a strategic shift in North Korea's military posture and its ability to project power at sea.
